# Monitoring Baseline -- Diagnostic Settings Done Right

**Version**: 1.0
**Date**: 2026-03-18
**Applies to**: All infrastructure generated by the infrastructure generator
**Source**: Microsoft Cloud Security Benchmark (MCSB) v1, NIS2 Directive, DORA Regulation

---

> Every Azure resource that supports diagnostic settings must have them enabled.
> This is not optional -- it is a regulatory and operational requirement. Without logs,
> you cannot investigate incidents, prove compliance, or troubleshoot outages.

## 1. Why Diagnostic Settings Matter

### Compliance Requirements

| Framework | Control | Requirement |
|-----------|---------|-------------|
| MCSB | LT-3 | Enable logging for security investigation |
| MCSB | LT-4 | Enable network logging (NSG flow logs, Firewall logs) |
| MCSB | LT-5 | Centralize security log management and analysis |
| MCSB | LT-6 | Configure log storage retention |
| NIS2 | Art. 21(2)(b) | Incident handling -- requires detection and logging |
| DORA | Art. 10 | Detection of anomalous activities |
| DORA | Art. 13 | Logging policies -- 30 to 365 days retention |
| RGPD | Art. 33 | Breach notification within 72h -- requires detection capability |

### Operational Reality

Without diagnostic settings:

- You cannot investigate security incidents
- You cannot prove compliance to auditors
- You cannot troubleshoot application failures
- You cannot detect anomalous behavior
- You cannot meet the 72-hour GDPR breach notification requirement

---

## 2. Log Analytics Workspace Setup

The Log Analytics workspace is the central log sink. One workspace per stack is the
default pattern -- shared workspaces are possible but increase blast radius.

**MCSB Control**: LT-5 (Centralize security log management and analysis)

```hcl
# monitoring.tf
module "log_analytics" {
  source  = "Azure/avm-res-operationalinsights-workspace/azurerm"
  version = "~> 0.4"

  name                = "log-${local.name_prefix}"
  resource_group_name = module.resource_group.name
  location            = var.location
  enable_telemetry    = false

  sku               = "PerGB2018"
  retention_in_days = var.log_retention_days

  tags = local.common_tags
}
```

### Workspace Sizing Guide

| Environment | Expected Volume | SKU | Retention | Estimated Cost |
|-------------|-----------------|-----|-----------|----------------|
| Dev / Test | < 1 GB/day | PerGB2018 | 30 days | ~EUR 5-15/month |
| Standard | 1-10 GB/day | PerGB2018 | 90 days | ~EUR 50-250/month |
| Premium / Regulated | 10-50 GB/day | PerGB2018 | 365 days | ~EUR 250-1200/month |

> **Tip**: The first 5 GB/day of ingestion is included in some plans. The `PerGB2018`
> SKU is the most cost-effective for workloads under 100 GB/day. Above that, consider
> commitment tiers.

### Retention Variable

```hcl
# variables.tf
variable "log_retention_days" {
  description = "Log Analytics workspace retention in days"
  type        = number
  default     = 90

  validation {
    condition     = contains([30, 60, 90, 120, 180, 270, 365, 730], var.log_retention_days)
    error_message = "Retention must be 30, 60, 90, 120, 180, 270, 365, or 730 days."
  }
}
```

## 3. Application Insights

For web applications (App Service, Function App, Container Apps), Application Insights
provides application-level telemetry: request traces, dependency tracking, exception
logging, and performance metrics.

```hcl
# monitoring.tf
module "app_insights" {
  source  = "Azure/avm-res-insights-component/azurerm"
  version = "~> 0.1"

  name                = "appi-${local.name_prefix}"
  resource_group_name = module.resource_group.name
  location            = var.location
  enable_telemetry    = false

  application_type    = "web"
  workspace_id        = module.log_analytics.resource_id
  retention_in_days   = var.log_retention_days

  tags = local.common_tags
}
```

### Connecting App Insights to App Service

```hcl
# app.tf
module "app_service" {
  # ...
  app_settings = {
    "APPLICATIONINSIGHTS_CONNECTION_STRING" = module.app_insights.connection_string
    "ApplicationInsightsAgent_EXTENSION_VERSION" = "~3"
  }
}
```

### What Application Insights Captures

| Telemetry Type | Description | Use Case |
|----------------|-------------|----------|
| Requests | HTTP requests to the app | Performance, error rates |
| Dependencies | Calls to databases, APIs, storage | Latency analysis |
| Exceptions | Unhandled and logged exceptions | Bug triage |
| Traces | Custom log messages | Debugging |
| Page Views | Client-side page loads | UX analysis (web apps) |
| Availability | Synthetic ping tests | Uptime monitoring |
| Performance Counters | CPU, memory, request queue | Capacity planning |

## 4. Diagnostic Settings Pattern

### AVM Module Pattern

AVM modules accept a `diagnostic_settings` parameter that creates the diagnostic
setting as part of the module call. This is the preferred pattern.

```hcl
# Example: Key Vault with diagnostic settings
module "keyvault" {
  source  = "Azure/avm-res-keyvault-vault/azurerm"
  version = "~> 0.9"

  name                = "kv-${local.name_prefix}"
  resource_group_name = module.resource_group.name
  location            = var.location
  tenant_id           = data.azurerm_client_config.current.tenant_id
  enable_telemetry    = false

  # ... other config ...

  diagnostic_settings = {
    to_law = {
      name                           = "diag-kv-${local.name_prefix}"
      workspace_resource_id          = module.log_analytics.resource_id
      log_groups                     = ["allLogs"]
      metric_categories              = ["AllMetrics"]
    }
  }
}
```

### Resource-Specific Log Categories

Not all resources emit the same log categories. Here are the most important ones:

| Resource | Key Log Categories | Key Metrics |
|----------|--------------------|-------------|
| Key Vault | AuditEvent | Availability, SaturationShoebox |
| Storage Account | StorageRead, StorageWrite, StorageDelete | Transactions, Availability |
| PostgreSQL | PostgreSQLLogs, QueryStoreRuntimeStatistics | cpu_percent, memory_percent |
| SQL Database | SQLSecurityAuditEvents, QueryStoreRuntimeStatistics | cpu_percent, dtu_used |
| App Service | AppServiceHTTPLogs, AppServiceAppLogs | Requests, AverageResponseTime |
| Virtual Network | VMProtectionAlerts | -- |
| NSG | NetworkSecurityGroupEvent, NetworkSecurityGroupRuleCounter | -- |
| Firewall | AzureFirewallApplicationRule, AzureFirewallNetworkRule | Throughput |

### Using `allLogs` vs Specific Categories

```hcl
# Option 1: All logs (recommended for simplicity)
diagnostic_settings = {
  to_law = {
    name                  = "diag-${local.name_prefix}"
    workspace_resource_id = module.log_analytics.resource_id
    log_groups            = ["allLogs"]
    metric_categories     = ["AllMetrics"]
  }
}

# Option 2: Specific categories (for cost control on high-volume resources)
diagnostic_settings = {
  to_law = {
    name                  = "diag-${local.name_prefix}"
    workspace_resource_id = module.log_analytics.resource_id
    log_categories        = ["AuditEvent"]  # Only audit events
    metric_categories     = ["AllMetrics"]
  }
}
```

> **When to use specific categories**: If a resource generates very high log volume
> (e.g., a busy Storage Account with millions of transactions), sending all logs
> can be expensive. In that case, select only security-relevant categories and use
> metrics for operational monitoring.

## 5. Retention Policy

### Retention by Tier

| Tier | Retention | Rationale | Regulatory Basis |
|------|-----------|-----------|------------------|
| **Basic** (dev/test) | 30 days | Cost optimization, non-production | -- |
| **Standard** (production) | 90 days | MCSB LT-6 minimum, operational needs | MCSB LT-6 |
| **Premium** (regulated) | 365 days | NIS2, DORA, financial regulation | NIS2 Art. 21(2)(b), DORA Art. 13 |

### Setting Retention in terraform.tfvars

```hcl
# terraform.tfvars -- basic tier
log_retention_days = 30

# terraform.tfvars -- standard tier
log_retention_days = 90

# terraform.tfvars -- premium tier
log_retention_days = 365
```

### Archive Strategy for Long-Term Retention

For retention beyond 730 days (regulatory archives), export logs to a Storage Account
with immutable blob storage:

```hcl
# monitoring.tf -- long-term archive (premium tier only)
diagnostic_settings = {
  to_law = {
    name                  = "diag-live-${local.name_prefix}"
    workspace_resource_id = module.log_analytics.resource_id
    log_groups            = ["allLogs"]
    metric_categories     = ["AllMetrics"]
  }
  to_storage = {
    name                       = "diag-archive-${local.name_prefix}"
    storage_account_resource_id = module.storage_logs.resource_id
    log_groups                 = ["allLogs"]
    metric_categories          = ["AllMetrics"]
  }
}
```

## 6. Alert Rules

### 6.1 Budget Alerts

Budget alerts are defined in `finops.tf` (see the FinOps Baseline document) but they
are a monitoring concern. Every stack must have at least one budget alert.

**MCSB Control**: (WAF Cost Optimization pillar)

### 6.2 Availability Alerts

```hcl
# monitoring.tf
resource "azurerm_monitor_metric_alert" "app_availability" {
  count = var.tier != "basic" ? 1 : 0

  name                = "alert-availability-${local.name_prefix}"
  resource_group_name = module.resource_group.name
  scopes              = [module.app_service.resource_id]
  description         = "Alert when app availability drops below 99.9%"
  severity            = 1
  frequency           = "PT5M"
  window_size         = "PT15M"

  criteria {
    metric_namespace = "Microsoft.Web/sites"
    metric_name      = "HealthCheckStatus"
    aggregation      = "Average"
    operator         = "LessThan"
    threshold        = 99.9
  }

  tags = local.common_tags
}
```

### 6.3 Performance Alerts

```hcl
# monitoring.tf
resource "azurerm_monitor_metric_alert" "db_cpu" {
  count = var.tier != "basic" ? 1 : 0

  name                = "alert-db-cpu-${local.name_prefix}"
  resource_group_name = module.resource_group.name
  scopes              = [module.postgresql.resource_id]
  description         = "Alert when database CPU exceeds 80% for 15 minutes"
  severity            = 2
  frequency           = "PT5M"
  window_size         = "PT15M"

  criteria {
    metric_namespace = "Microsoft.DBforPostgreSQL/flexibleServers"
    metric_name      = "cpu_percent"
    aggregation      = "Average"
    operator         = "GreaterThan"
    threshold        = 80
  }

  tags = local.common_tags
}
```

### 6.4 Security Alerts

```hcl
# monitoring.tf
resource "azurerm_monitor_metric_alert" "kv_unauthorized" {
  count = var.tier != "basic" ? 1 : 0

  name                = "alert-kv-unauth-${local.name_prefix}"
  resource_group_name = module.resource_group.name
  scopes              = [module.keyvault.resource_id]
  description         = "Alert on unauthorized Key Vault access attempts"
  severity            = 1
  frequency           = "PT5M"
  window_size         = "PT5M"

  criteria {
    metric_namespace = "Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults"
    metric_name      = "ServiceApiResult"
    aggregation      = "Count"
    operator         = "GreaterThan"
    threshold        = 0

    dimension {
      name     = "StatusCode"
      operator = "Include"
      values   = ["401", "403"]
    }
  }

  tags = local.common_tags
}
```

### Alert Severity Guide

| Severity | Level | Meaning | Response Time |
|----------|-------|---------|---------------|
| 0 | Critical | Service down, data at risk | Immediate |
| 1 | Error | Significant degradation, security event | < 1 hour |
| 2 | Warning | Performance degradation, approaching limits | < 4 hours |
| 3 | Informational | Trend to watch, non-urgent anomaly | Next business day |
| 4 | Verbose | Debug information | No action required |

## 7. Complete monitoring.tf Example

```hcl
# monitoring.tf
# =============================================================================
# Log Analytics Workspace + Application Insights + Alerts
# MCSB: LT-3 (logging), LT-5 (centralize), LT-6 (retention)
# NIS2: Art. 21(2)(b) — incident detection
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Log Analytics Workspace
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
module "log_analytics" {
  source  = "Azure/avm-res-operationalinsights-workspace/azurerm"
  version = "~> 0.4"

  name                = "log-${local.name_prefix}"
  resource_group_name = module.resource_group.name
  location            = var.location
  enable_telemetry    = false

  sku               = "PerGB2018"
  retention_in_days = var.log_retention_days

  tags = local.common_tags
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Application Insights (for web app stacks)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
module "app_insights" {
  source  = "Azure/avm-res-insights-component/azurerm"
  version = "~> 0.1"

  count = var.enable_app_insights ? 1 : 0

  name                = "appi-${local.name_prefix}"
  resource_group_name = module.resource_group.name
  location            = var.location
  enable_telemetry    = false

  application_type  = "web"
  workspace_id      = module.log_analytics.resource_id
  retention_in_days = var.log_retention_days

  tags = local.common_tags
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Budget Alert
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
resource "azurerm_consumption_budget_resource_group" "main" {
  name              = "budget-${local.name_prefix}"
  resource_group_id = module.resource_group.resource_id

  amount     = var.monthly_budget
  time_grain = "Monthly"

  time_period {
    start_date = formatdate("YYYY-MM-01'T'00:00:00Z", timestamp())
  }

  notification {
    enabled        = true
    threshold      = 80
    operator       = "GreaterThanOrEqualTo"
    threshold_type = "Actual"
    contact_emails = var.alert_emails
  }

  notification {
    enabled        = true
    threshold      = 100
    operator       = "GreaterThanOrEqualTo"
    threshold_type = "Forecasted"
    contact_emails = var.alert_emails
  }

  lifecycle {
    ignore_changes = [time_period]
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Availability Alert (standard + premium)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
resource "azurerm_monitor_metric_alert" "availability" {
  count = var.tier != "basic" && var.enable_app_insights ? 1 : 0

  name                = "alert-avail-${local.name_prefix}"
  resource_group_name = module.resource_group.name
  scopes              = [module.app_service.resource_id]
  description         = "App availability below threshold"
  severity            = 1
  frequency           = "PT5M"
  window_size         = "PT15M"

  criteria {
    metric_namespace = "Microsoft.Web/sites"
    metric_name      = "HealthCheckStatus"
    aggregation      = "Average"
    operator         = "LessThan"
    threshold        = 99
  }

  tags = local.common_tags
}
```
